    "My past Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing desire for seasonal music, although that preference depends on the occasion.",
    "An interest in vocal performers seems to have been stretched into an interest in any vocal collection, while the calmness and warmth of the music matter to my choice."

  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent selection, The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe, makes a peaceful listening mood especially relevant right now.",
